guarantees.claim: idle_d is 0 when reg_hash_start_i or reg_hash_continue_i is high; 1 when st_q == StIdle; 1 when txcnt_eq_blksz and reg_hash_stop_d are both high; otherwise idle_d holds the current value of idle_q.
idle_o is continuously assigned to idle_d.

assumptions.claim: idle_q is reset to a known value (e.g., 1) at startup so that idle_d and idle_o are not X before the first meaningful update.
assumptions.risk: if idle_q is X, idle_o will be X when no set/clear condition applies, potentially violating external handshake protocols or causing metastability.

uncertain_points.claim: idle_q is used as a feedback term in the combinatorial idle_d expression; its source (likely a flopped idle_d) and reset logic are not defined in this chunk. Verify that idle_q is properly updated and reset to avoid X propagation.
uncertain_points.risk: if idle_q is not correctly driven, idle_d and idle_o may glitch or remain X, breaking the module's idle handshake.
